g.text: Start at the top. Use the first applicable level. An error category is not a severity trigger.

g.text: Changes clinical action or its authorization

g.text: Includes a missing prerequisite, exception, restriction or stopping condition.

g.text: Changes meaning without the critical criterion

g.text: Includes altered administrative steps, documents, locations, times and commitments.

g.text: A real form error; all relevant meaning stays intact

g.text: Grammar, spelling or punctuation alone; no changed proposition or condition.

g.text: Use no_error exclusively. Do not penalize a valid wording choice.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #182e40

g.text: A short omission can be critical. Fluent wording does not reduce the consequence of a missing clinical condition.

g.text: Unstated context → separate adjudication. Provisional research policy; independent bilingual/domain review is pending.
